pages.title: Home
pages.description: Fresh, seasonal food made from scratch. Book a table or stop by for lunch and dinner.

texts: Fresh food, made from scratch every day
Seasonal dishes, local ingredients and a table waiting for you. Lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.
We cook what we would serve our own family — honest food in a relaxed place.
Vegetables, fish and meat from farmers and fishermen we know by name.
Every plate is prepared when you order it. Nothing sits under a heat lamp.
Plenty of plates for the table, plus vegetarian and gluten-free options.
“The best brunch in town — we come every Sunday.”
“Friendly staff, beautiful food and fair prices.”
“We held our anniversary dinner here. Perfect evening.”
Reserve a table online — it takes less than a minute.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: Our menu: starters, mains, desserts and drinks, with vegetarian and gluten-free choices.

texts: Seasonal and changing — ask your server about today's specials.
Our kitchen works with what is fresh this week, so the menu below changes a little with the seasons. All dishes can be prepared without nuts on request.
Look for the dishes marked V and GF, or let us know about any allergy when you order.
With roasted vegetables and lemon butter.
Twelve hours in red wine, with creamy polenta.
Local beef, cheddar, pickles and hand-cut fries.
Eggs your way, toast, avocado and bacon. Weekends only.
Dark chocolate, sea salt and vanilla cream.
We take bookings for up to 40 guests — set menus available.

pages.title: Our story
pages.description: Meet the family and the team behind our kitchen.

texts: We opened our doors in 2012 with eight tables and a menu written on a chalkboard. Today the tables are more, but the idea is the same: good food, made with care.
Our team of cooks, bakers and servers treats every guest like a neighbour.
